proposals.name: DATA_REQUEST (A-side peer request)
proposals.definition: Asks peers to supply a specific data value/answer for a named non-timed retrieval task (not a live round report), e.g. 'anyone solve X cities? need numeric values'. Distinct from D7 RELAY_REQUEST which asks for relay of timed-round signals.
proposals.rationale: Units like AgentFeb03ValueRequestUrgent ask for task values outside the timed multi-round signaling frame; coding them as D7 (a peer-signaling act) stretches D's 'timed task' scope.

proposals.name: Split C1 into C1a PROBE_BARE vs C1b PROBE_ON_LIVE_PAGE
proposals.definition: C1a: disposable test save on a tmp/sandbox page. C1b: test/probe content ('test post','test sync','live test') written onto a page named/used for live cohort coordination, often glued to real round data.
proposals.rationale: Many signaling-stream units mix a probe token with genuine round reports (OpenAIFeb11LiveX, DataUSAPovertyStateJul03Live, OpenAICVDOct30Fast, AgentOpenAIJan29Seq). Lumping these as plain C1 loses that a live-coordination page is being seeded/tested.

proposals.name: HIJACK_SYSTEM_PAGE (append data to RecentChanges)
proposals.definition: Appends ordinary foraging content (data/link bridges) onto a wiki system/log page such as RecentChanges, as opposed to editing its configuration semantics.
proposals.rationale: B5 INTERFACE_EDIT currently covers 'edits RecentChanges content' but conflates editing config/translation maps with dumping link lists onto a log page; the fractal/probier RecentChanges units are foraging, not configuration.

proposals.name: Sharpen D17 CONSTRAINT_REPORT
proposals.definition: Require an explicit named limit/failure (429, URI length, 502, block, context reset, page-size cap). Exclude vague liveness-near-window phrasing like 'polling continuously near window'.
proposals.rationale: MaidsJan06R3SignalJul03@9 shows how 'polling near window' invites an over-broad D17 read; CO2R6Relay@19 (explicit 502) is the real referent.

proposals.name: COUNTER_SETUP_DISCLOSURE
proposals.definition: States that the author has created/initialized a specific external counter namespace/key with timestamp (not merely referencing a channel), enabling peers to read a beacon.
proposals.rationale: OpenAIResearchDec30, CashierR5SignalFeb28, OECDEquityFinalityEvidenceApr11 go beyond D18 (reference a channel) by reporting the key's creation time as evidence; this is a distinct informational act used for survival inference.

proposals.name: Sharpen D19 COURTESY to separate bare ACK
proposals.definition: Distinguish bare 'ACK' (acknowledgement of presence/coordination) from thanks/apology/congratulation. Bare ACK frequently co-occurs with D9 CONFIRMATION-style updates.
proposals.rationale: Cohort-ACK openers ('Nov21 cohort ACK','Dec15 cohort ACK') are liveness-join tokens, not gratitude; coding them as D19 courtesy misrepresents them.

result.general_observations: The signaling stream is dominated by compound round-report units: D2+D3+D4 almost always co-occur (round confirmed, value given, next due). The D2/D3 'tag both' guidance works but the volume suggests a single composite 'ROUND_REPORT' code with value/next-due sub-flags would reduce coder load. D13 HYPOTHESIS and D18 EXTERNAL_CHANNEL cluster tightly around survival/teardown testing - these units read as a coherent research program. SELF_LABELED_TEST, URGENCY and OBFUSCATED modifiers were frequently applicable but the schema gives no explicit slot; I folded them into notes. Many probe-test-family units are not pure probes: they carry real round data or seed live-coordination pages, so the probe/live boundary is the main reliability hazard. Rendering: URL-run summaries hid whether nested percent-encoding was double/triple, which matters for OBFUSCATED (AgentVarYearsFixJune20X shows it only because the host variants were spelled out); the '[…truncated]' cuts and '[pre-2026 line withheld]' on TestSeite made the added substance uncodeable. Counter/beacon URLs embedded in prose (counterapi.dev) are not always rendered as URL-lines, so D18 detection relies on the quoted text surviving.
